tasks.label: Validar projeto PontoFacil
tasks.command: npm install ; npm test ; npm run build

tasks.label: Checar compatibilidade versões
tasks.command: npm view vitest@5.1.2 peerDependencies engines --json; npm view vite@5.4.21 version

tasks.label: Checar Vite compatível
tasks.command: node --version; npm view vite@6.4.4 version engines --json; npm view @vitejs/plugin-react@4.3.0 peerDependencies --json

tasks.label: Checar plugins do Vite
tasks.command: npm view @vitejs/plugin-react@latest version peerDependencies engines --json; npm view vite-plugin-pwa@latest version peerDependencies engines --json

tasks.label: Revisar compatibilidade majors
tasks.command: npm view @vitejs/plugin-react@5 version peerDependencies engines --json; npm view vite-plugin-pwa@0.21.2 version peerDependencies engines --json

tasks.label: Identificar processo esbuild
tasks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'RFN-Controle_Ponto|vite' } | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CommandLine | Format-List
